label: Order
caption: NOVARTIS PHARMACEUTICALS CORPORATION V. HEC PHARM CO., LTD., ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, case No. 2021-1070, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, October 5, 2022, by noon (EDT).
